input.command: echo "HOME=$HOME"; ls -la ~/Library/Logs 2>/dev/null | grep -i maude; find ~/Library/Application\ Support -maxdepth 1 -iname "*maude*" 2>/dev/null; find ~ -maxdepth 4 -iname "*maude*" 2>/dev/null | grep -v claude-instances | head -50
ls -la .design/_state; echo "---"; for f in .design/_state/*; do echo "== $f =="; if [ -d "$f" ]; then ls -la "$f"; fi; done
for f in "/Users/iagh/Library/Application Support/com.maude.app/crashes"/*.log; do echo "== $f =="; ls -la "$f"; done

head -5 "/Users/iagh/Library/Logs/com.maude.app/server.log"; echo "...."; grep -n "^\[" "/Users/iagh/Library/Logs/com.maude.app/server.log" | grep -iE "T[0-9]{2}:[0-9]{2}|2026-" | head -5
echo "---count sync rejections---"
grep -c "hub auth rejections" "/Users/iagh/Library/Logs/com.maude.app/server.log"
echo "---first occurrence line number---"
grep -n "hub auth rejections" "/Users/iagh/Library/Logs/com.maude.app/server.log" | head -1
echo "---last occurrence---"
grep -n "hub auth rejections" "/Users/iagh/Library/Logs/com.maude.app/server.log" | tail -1
echo "---total lines---"
wc -l "/Users/iagh/Library/Logs/com.maude.app/server.log"
echo "---ERROR/fail grep---"
grep -niE "error|exception|fatal" "/Users/iagh/Library/Logs/com.maude.app/server.log" | grep -v "renderMediaOnWeb failed" | tail -30

sed -n '1850,1870p' "/Users/iagh/Library/Logs/com.maude.app/server.log"; echo "---elevenlabs---"; sed -n '1495,1515p' "/Users/iagh/Library/Logs/com.maude.app/server.log"; echo "---video timeout ctx---"; sed -n '8280,8310p' "/Users/iagh/Library/Logs/com.maude.app/server.log"
